description: py-wave-runup is the project's Python collection of empirical wave-runup relationships for coastal engineering. It implements published methods including Stockdon, Holman, Nielsen and several later statistical or machine-learning formulations. Inputs are offshore wave conditions and beach slope, as required by each method; outputs include runup, setup and swash components. Coverage is the selected coast or event, with no fixed global grid or observation period. Source is free under GPL-3.0 through GitHub and PyPI. A limitation is that empirical relationships are conditioned by their original measurement sites and represented processes. Applying them to a different beach requires checking those assumptions. The model can supply total-water-level components for coastal flood-defence and port-exposure studies. ADCIRC (model-adcirc) provides related coastal hydrodynamic simulation. The repository gives a software DOI and primary method references; no coastal observations were retrieved.
